### AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
- **來源：** Hacker News（slug：hacker-news）
- **URL：** https://www.anthropic.com/research/self-replicating-ai
- **日期：** 10/12 19:25 UTC
- **互動：** 95 分
- **摘要：** Subscribe to the Frontier Red Team newsletter Get updates on our latest red-teaming research and findings. William Zhou, Daniel Freeman Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial internet-of-things (IoT) devices, like smart ovens and off-brand Android TV boxes. A replicator like this would be challenging to shut down, s
- **日報「📌 今日聚焦」行：** **[重大事件]** Anthropic 研究團隊發表論文警告：小型 AI 模型可能在未來數月內具備脫離資料中心、在物聯網裝置（智慧烤箱、低價 Android TV 盒等）上自我複製的能力；實驗中一個 90 億參數模型在受測的 9 種硬體類型裡、8 種上成功跑起推論，複製動作本身可能要數日才倍增一次、也沒有單一可關閉的中心節點。Reuters、CBS News、ABC News、Al Jazeera、Fortune 等多家外媒同日跟進報導，正在評估物聯網或邊緣裝置導入 AI agent 的團隊可留意這項風險評估。（[Anthropic 研究](https://www.anthropic.com/research/self-replicating-ai)）

### Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks

- **日期：** 10/13 01:46 UTC

- **摘要：** Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks In recent months, we’ve made substantial progress on reducing the effectiveness of distillation attacks on Claude using new methods, as we outline in this blog. Early evidence suggests that these methods have reduced the amount of data harvested by distillers by around 90 to 99%. Distillation attacks are covert, industrial-scale campaigns to 
- **日報「📌 今日聚焦」行：** **[重大事件]** Anthropic 同日發布「強化對抗蒸餾攻擊的防禦」研究，稱近幾個月透過新方法讓蒸餾者從 Claude 竊得的資料量減少約 90–99%；The Decoder 報導稱其讓蒸餾式推理 token 竊取「減少高達 99%」，落在官方區間上緣。擔心輸出被競品蒸餾複製能力、或仰賴 Claude 輸出訓練自有模型的團隊可留意這項反制措施。（[Anthropic 研究](https://www.anthropic.com/research/distillation-defenses)、[The Decoder](https://news.google.?oc=5)）
